translations.web: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
translations.bsb: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.
translations.kjv: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
translations.asv: O Jehovah, our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth, Who hast set thy glory upon the heavens!
